## Source and licence checklist (required for data PRs)

- [ ] Every item has `source` (exam name + session) and, where available, `source_url`
- [ ] The `license` tag matches `data/{lang}/LICENSES.md` and I have personally confirmed the legal basis
- [ ] No item copies copyrighted passages (reading comprehension texts, figures, images)
- [ ] No personal data in questions or choices
- [ ] `python tools/validate.py` passes locally
- [ ] (test split) at least two reviewers listed in `reviewed_by`
